title: Binary Tree Inorder Traversal
summary: Return the node values in this recursive visitation order: left subtree, current node, right subtree.

contractDetails.constraints: 0–100 nodes, each with a value in [−100,100]. Input uses level-order values with null for absent children, omitting trailing nulls. Return an integer array in the required order.
contractDetails.output-checking: Build a TreeNode tree from canonical level-order input. Return and compare the inorder integer sequence.

statement: Return the node values in this recursive visitation order: left subtree, current node, right subtree. Apply the same rule inside each subtree. An absent child contributes no values.

examples.explanation: The missing left child of 2 contributes no values.
An empty tree has no visits.

constraints: 0–100 nodes, each with a value in [−100,100]. Input uses level-order values with null for absent children, omitting trailing nulls. Return an integer array in the required order.
hints: Conceptual: Each node has a specific place between its two subtrees.
Directional: Explore the left subtree before recording its parent.
Implementation: Use a stack to remember parents while walking left. Pop, record, and then walk right.
complexityAnalysis: O(n) time and O(h) traversal stack space, excluding O(n) output, where h is tree height.
